_comment: Direction A, Ledger evolved. Light theme. Every text pair the screens use is claimed here; node site/scripts/check-contrast.mjs measures it.

ink.role: Text, primary button fill, focus ring, strong rules.

paper.role: Page surface. Text on the ink button.

sunken.role: Wells: the document frame, table heads.

mint.role: OK stamp fill under ink text.

stamp.role: Needs you and missing. Words, borders, the missing fill.

stampWash.role: Danger surface behind a needs-you note.

onStamp.role: Text on the missing stamp fill.
